observations: Revision 113 preserves the repository-local blind-holder gate as PASS while the task-level objective, user-level objective, and AGI objective remain false; that gate is enabling protocol evidence, not a capability result.

The earlier clean_g1 scientific forecast remains a contaminated FAIL because outcome-bearing retrieval preceded the frozen prediction boundary and same-session isolation was unproven; it must never be rerun, relabeled, or upgraded.

The next highest-value bounded unit is one genuinely new post-revision-113 clean_g1 live held-out forecast. It requires an independent holder and an independent predictor with externally checkable receipts, and must fail closed as NOT_EVALUABLE before any outcome-bearing retrieval if either independent surface is unavailable.

local_learn.observation: The blind-holder gate now supports a new provenance-bound live trial, but it is not itself evidence of live forecasting capability. Run exactly one new source/task through independent holder and predictor surfaces; if independence cannot be established before retrieval, record NOT_EVALUABLE without synthetic substitution, baseline fabrication, or activation.
